method: session-assisted open web discovery; no paid model/provider run or numerical scoring

leads.subject: Read a burned scroll without opening it
leads.premise: How do you read writing inside a scroll that would crumble if you opened it?
leads.pull: The ordinary route to an answer destroys the evidence; an actual solution exists.
leads.payoff: Volume → traced surface → ink signal → flat image; understand recovering information without opening its carrier.
leads.comparison: Strongest combined pull/payoff: the central obstacle and solution require neither domain enthusiasm nor provocative wording.
leads.access: Full primary body inspected; sufficient bounded mechanism, paired investigator account.

leads.subject: Shrimp sound comes from a collapsing bubble
leads.premise: Why does a tiny shrimp make its loud snap after its claw has already closed?
leads.pull: A delayed sound challenges the assumption that the claw collision makes the noise.
leads.payoff: Claw jet → low pressure → cavitation → collapse; align high-speed camera and hydrophone.
leads.comparison: Close rival with strong causal reversal; the scroll has a richer information-recovery task. This is qualitative judgment, not a biology penalty.
leads.access: Primary paper parsed body inspected around synchronization and cavitation; PDF text misrenders microsecond symbols, so no timing numbers adopted.

leads.subject: Glacier retreat reroutes a river toward another ocean
leads.premise: How can a river lose its water to a different ocean?
leads.pull: A stable-looking watershed changes destination when a new outlet wins the flow.
leads.payoff: Ice retreat → lower outlet → meltwater diversion → deprived channel; drainage divide matters.
leads.comparison: Strong rival; map is essential to distinguish rerouting supply from an entire river literally vanishing.
leads.access: NASA explanatory body inspected; original Nature Geoscience paper located, full claim review remains pending.

leads.subject: A false identity carried a wartime deception
leads.premise: How did a fabricated identity make secret invasion plans look believable?
leads.pull: Consequential adversarial plan hinges on why an enemy would trust planted material.
leads.payoff: Construct identity and documents, recovery chain, assessed effects; distinguish contribution from sole invasion cause.
leads.comparison: Potentially strong narrative; short treatment must preserve the dead person’s dignity and avoid claiming this alone won Sicily.
leads.access: Museum historical account inspected; operational primary records and causal attribution need deeper work.

leads.subject: Attention can hide something in plain sight
leads.premise: How can you look straight at an event and fail to notice it?
leads.pull: Personal confidence in seeing is challenged without clinical sensationalism.
leads.payoff: Focused task, unexpected event, attention limits; distinguish experimental misses from universal blindness.
leads.comparison: Strong question, but a familiar gorilla reenactment could spoil the reveal; a new truthful demonstration requires experiment and rights review.
leads.access: University search lead acquired; body access error; not independently verified, original study not yet inspected.

leads.subject: Rotation and solar day are different clocks
leads.premise: How can Venus finish an orbit before one full spin, yet have a shorter sunrise-to-sunrise day?
leads.pull: Two apparently incompatible clocks need a frame-of-reference explanation.
leads.payoff: Separate spin relative to stars from rotation relative to moving Sun; retrograde orbit geometry.
leads.comparison: Truthful reframing has worthwhile payoff but spends much of the opening defining clocks; not as immediate as scroll or bubble.
leads.access: NASA tabulated rotation/orbit/solar-day distinctions inspected; original broad day-longer-than-year wording rejected.
